reelsMeta.period: Reels published October 10 – November 10, 2026, as listed on 13 November 2026
reelsMeta.discrepancy: The research brief recorded roughly 16,600–42,100 views. The live Fohr page on 13 Nov 2026 lists 16,629–56,031 for Reels in that window; the displayed figures follow the live page. 42.1K does not appear in the page. Other Reels on the page (June 2 and July 20, 2026) show 33,006 and 37,732 views.
